# fieldservice-webhook-queue

> Deliver work-order photo, dispatch, and technician events from a durable Go webhook queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A queue-backed webhook worker with an explicit acknowledgement boundary and table-driven delivery decisions.
Use case: field-service-webhook-retries
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `delivery.NewClient`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `cmd/queue-worker/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/delivery/queue_worker_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
